notes.probe: The radial lanes and terracotta house ring read from the opening crane position. As the camera lowers, the striped stalls and the open well rim become clear in the plaza.
notes.timeline: The cobblestone circle and clay-roof houses establish the miniature at the start. The crane-in reveals window surrounds, bunting and vendors. Near the end, brightly painted figures stand and move between the well, traders and adjacent lanes, with the foreground roofs naturally leaving the frame.
notes.angles: The wide and oblique plates show both house rings, paths and trees around the central set. The top view traces the camera route down a clear lane toward the well, with the whole exterior site still present.
notes.playback: The sampled decoded sequence shows a gradual descent, warm side shadows across the plaza and agent movement between homes, stalls and the well. The fixed gatherers turn in place while the walkers follow visibly different routes.
notes.jev_look_items: Interpenetration (0.31): figures occasionally overlap in projection where paths cross, but the close frames retain body outlines and the ground contact. Noise (0.48): fine cobblestone joints and tile grooves soften slightly at preview samples. Clipping (0.43): the nearest houses are intentionally framed out as the camera descends into the plaza, and the wide angle shows the clear camera lane. Set unfinished (0.42): the oblique proof shows a modeled ring of homes, trees, lanes, stalls and the decorated gathering area around the well, all sized for the miniature.
